claims.text: Antitussive (dextromethorphan) with or without a mucolytic (guaifenesin), only if the cough is distressing or interferes with sleep;
claims.quote: Antitussives (dextromethorphan) with or without mucolytics (guaifenesin) should be considered only if the cough is distressing or interfering with sleep.
